question.text: Number of oxygen atoms shared per <math> <mrow> <msubsup> <mtext>SiO</mtext> <mn>4</mn> <mrow> <mn>4</mn> <mo>-</mo> </mrow> </msubsup> </mrow> </math> tetrahedron in single chain silicates are ______

solution.text: In case of simple chain silicate, two corners of each tetrahedron are shared and they form a long chain of tetrahedron. Their general formula is also same as the cyclic silicates i.e., <math> <mrow> <msubsup> <mrow> <msub> <mrow> <mtext>(SiO</mtext></mrow> <mtext>3</mtext> </msub> <mtext>)</mtext></mrow> <mtext>n</mtext> <mrow> <mtext>2n</mtext><mo>−</mo></mrow> </msubsup> </mrow> </math>
